intro: Warmaster Laggrond is a seasoned orc commander stationed outside the Horde entrance to Alterac Valley in the Alterac Mountains. He oversees recruitment and frontline recognition for warriors answering the call to aid the Frostwolf clan. Through his trials, fighters prove their mettle and earn the respect of the Horde vanguard.

p: Standing watch in the bitter cold at the threshold of Alterac Valley, Warmaster Laggrond organizes the Horde's war effort against the Stormpike Expedition. He ensures that only capable fighters enter the valley to represent the Frostwolf clan and the wider Horde.

Laggrond tests arriving combatants through the Proving Grounds before directing them into the thick of battle. As warriors spill blood across the frozen peaks, it is Laggrond who measures their standing, bestowing honors upon those who earn renown among the Frostwolves.
